mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WISH (WISH_NUM, COMPANY_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, WISH_DATE) VALUES (WISH_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{companyNum}, #{memberNum}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT WISH_NUM, COMPANY_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, WISH_DATE FROM WISH WHERE COMPANY_NUM = #{companyNum} AND MEMBER_NUM = (SELECT MEMBER_NUM FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId})

SELECT w.WISH_NUM, w.COMPANY_NUM, w.MEMBER_NUM, w.WISH_DATE, c.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName FROM WISH w JOIN COMPANY c ON w.COMPANY_NUM = c.COMPANY_NUM WHERE w.MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} ORDER BY w.WISH_DATE DESC
